title: fix(metadata-protocol)!: `?package=`, the qualified path and `_env` name the exact holder for every package-scoped type, and a by-name read the registry cannot judge fails closed (ADR-0150 D3/D5)
body:
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBQTz1Y8LLtgpShFko6FJddy)_ Fixes #32076 Clause-②: yes (narrowing) Metadata-protocol: none Skills-docs: none — `skills/**` teaches no `?package=`, qualified or `_env` read of a name the address does not hold. The pair reads `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` teaches (no `?package`, `?package=`, the base's address serving the pair's added locale) keep their answer, pinned by `packages/objectql/src/protocol-bundle-member-base-address.test.ts`. Claim by `domain:server#4` (takeover 6764466393), seat rulings in claim amendments 6760935468, 6760990217, 6764797602 (rulings (a), (b), (c)) 6764879174 (option A, `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`, the pair exception) and 6769597149 (the `rest` source paths of the layered probe). Reader card for #31700 under epic #31527 (ADR-0150). This resumes the dead branch `claude/project-thread-p9al1d` (head 25d7c420); every inherited commit was re-read and re-verified here. ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么：按名读元数据时，`?package=`、限定路径 `/meta/:type/:ns/:name` 和 `_env` 现在对全部 24 个包作用域类型都按「精确持有者」判定，原先只判注册表按包读取的 13 个。另外，引擎的注册表缺少包作用域解析器时，这类读取直接拒绝（501），不再按第一个匹配项作答。分层读取（`/layers`）的「停用包」预检现在带上所读的 member。 - 为什么改：注册表仍通过 `getItem` 读取的其余 11 个类型（flow、action、hook、job、webhook、connector、permission、sharing_rule、queue、assignment_rule、email_template）中，`?package=X` 读一个 X 并不持有的名字时，会回 200，内容却是另一个包的条目。 - 风险与回滚：这三种读取由 200 改为 409，并列出所有持有者（无人持有仍是 404）。持有者自己的读取、不带包的裸读、定制配对包的读取都不变。仓内所有组合都基于 ObjectQL 的 `SchemaRegistry`，所以 501 那条在仓内不会触发。回滚即 revert。 - 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-exact-qualifier.ts`（`unjudgeableCause`、`admitExactQualifier`、`admitEnvironmentQualifier`、`exactQualifierItem` 里的配对包那一行），然后看 `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts` 里的 `isDeclaredRefusal` 与停用包预检。 - 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts`，预期全部通过（按未接线类型参数化，条数随兄弟 PR 接线而变）。 - 需要你做的：无，席位落地。 ## What changes - **`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-exact-qualifier.ts`** - **(c) The exact qualifier judges every covered type.** `admitExactQualifier` (`?package=X`, and the qualified path, which reads as `?package=`) and `admitEnvironmentQualifier` (`_env`) now run G1's judgment for every type in core's static `PACKAGE_SCOPED_TYPES`. Before, they ran it only when the registry answered `readsByPackage(type)` true, which is 13 types on `main` today (10 at the card's start, and then the sibling readers #32070, #32071 and #32098 added `picklist`, `mapping` and `dataset`). A name the address does not hold is `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` `not-held-by-qualifier` naming every holder; a name nobody holds still reads its own miss (404). - **A pair's item stays on its base's address.** `exactQualifierItem` keeps an item served by a customization pair of the package the address names (or of a base it admitted): ADR-0146 D2 serves the pair's override and added bundle member on the base's address. Without this line, (c) turned the base's `?package=` read of its pair's added `email_template` locale into a 404. The objectql suite caught it in `protocol-bundle-member-base-address.test.ts`. - **Fails closed when it cannot judge.** On a registry without the three reads the judgment needs (`packageScopedHoldersOf`, `getEnvironmentScopedItem`, `getPackageScopedItem`), a `?package=`, qualified or `_env` read of a covered type is `501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED` with `refusal: true`. The sentence names the missing package-scoped resolver. For a read naming no package (`unjudgeableCause` with `refuseUnjudgeableByNameRead`): - (a) a type the registry reads through `getItem` (`readsByPackage` false) keeps that read; - (b) unless the type's names are scoped to the namespace (`agent`, `skill`: two packages may hold the name), which is 501; - a registry with no `readsByPackage`, or with `readsByPackage` true but no `resolveItem`, is 501. - **`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-item-reads.ts`**: the read naming no package calls `refuseUnjudgeableByNameRead` before any layer is read. Comments are updated. - **`packages/core/src/package-scoped-resolution.ts`** and **`packages/objectql/src/bare-name-one-holder.ts`** (ruling option A): `NAMESPACE_SCOPED_BARE_NAME_TYPES` (`['agent', 'skill']`, value unchanged) and `isNamespaceScopedBareNameType` move to core beside `BARE_NAME_ONE_HOLDER_TYPES`, so the protocol can read them (objectql depends on the protocol). objectql re-exports both. `PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES` is not touched. - **`packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts`** (ruling option A): the `/meta` by-name read's catch re-throws an error with `refusal === true` (local `isDeclaredRefusal`), beside `isPackageScopedRefusal`. So the 501 is answered and never falls through to the by-name `MetadataService` read. - **Census for the ruling's condition.** On `main` (171cf6d9; re-read at 036a9fbf and fb71296c) the only `refusal = true` thrower in `packages/metadata-protocol/src` is `findReferencesToMeta` (`protocol-diff-delete-load.ts:1551`), which `getMetaItem` does not reach. `core/src/package-scoped-resolution.ts:522` sets `refusal` to the refusal object, never `true`. The other `refusal: true` sites (rest analytics routes, service-analytics, service-storage) sit outside the `getMetaItem` path. - **`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`**, **`packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts`**, **`packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts`**: the layered read's disabled-package probe (`isItemOfDisabledPackage`, step 1b of `createMetaLayeredAnswer`) now reads the member the layers were read at. Before, it asked the plain read with no member, so it read the bundle's canonical member. Under (c), `GET /meta/email_template//layers?package=&member=fr-FR` (a dependent's added locale) was then judged at the base's canonical member and refused 409, and the probe propagates a rejection as a fault. The dogfood battery caught it (`email-template-dependent-unshipped-locale-read.dogfood.test.ts`, #28830). - **Merge fix 1d05215c**: the inherited main merge (25d7c420) dropped the close of the objectql "fail closed" describe (`});\n});`) and the next docblock's opener. 1d05215c restores them. ### Measured compositions Every in-repo composition mounts the protocol on ObjectQL's `SchemaRegistry` (through `assembleMetadataProtocol`). - That registry carries all four reads, so the 501 arms change no answer in the repo. It reads `agent` and `skill` by package, so (b) changes none either. - At fbcfe53f, `readsByPackage` answered false for 14 covered types. Measured on it then: with `flow`, `picklist` and `mapping` each held by packages alpha and beta, `?package=gamma` answered alpha's item (200), and so did the bare read. Since then, the sibling readers #32070, #32071 and #32098 have wired `picklist`, `mapping` and `dataset`, so 11 remain. - After (c), `?package=gamma`, the qualified path of gamma's namespace, and `_env` of a package-held name are 409 naming alpha and beta. The bare read keeps alpha's (a). The objectql pins assert this for each of the 11 types. Their set is derived (`PACKAGE_SCOPED_TYPES` minus `PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES`), so it shrinks as reader children wire more types. `repo:cloud`: please check whether your worker's composition mounts the protocol on an engine whose registry lacks `packageScopedHoldersOf`, `getEnvironmentScopedItem`, `getPackageScopedItem` or `readsByPackage`. Such a composition now answers 501 for these reads. ### Stub test files (no assertion changes) The 501 arms refuse on a test double that lacks the reads. So each existing double that reaches a by-name read of a covered type gets the reads, with no assertion change. - **`packages/metadata-protocol` (25 files, under the 30-file stop).** Each spreads the new `NO_PACKAGE_SCOPED_READS` testkit (`no-package-scoped-reads.testkit.ts`): `readsByPackage` false and no package holder, so every type reads through `getItem` as before. The files are `protocol..test.ts` for: `app-package-id-key`, `audit-field-governance`, `copy-doors-inherited-grants`, `draft-publish-verdict`, `flow-by-name-shipped-name`, `flow-layered-shipped-name`, `injected-system-columns`, `item-execution-read`, `list-slot-prefer-local`, `lock-door-read-agree`, `metadata-redaction`, `named-base-overlay-write`, `packageless-save-address`, `read-decorations`, `read-lock-flags-write-door`, `reads-environment-only`, `restore-doors-save-refusal-family`, `row-binding-column`, `runtime-authoring-gate`, `save-door-lock-family`, `save-flow-canonicalization`, `scoped-list-fallback`, `stored-conversions`, `unknown-grant-object-refusal`, `view-container-reset-expansions`. - Some of these also import the lint-root preload (f4e8ca99). That pays the dynamic-import roots' first load at collection, so a first test does not time out. - `read-lock-flags-write-door` also reads `agent` by package through a one-item-per-name `resolveItem`. Its bare `agent` read is otherwise (b)'s 501. - **Outside the stop, each with a reason.** Each double already reads a covered type through `getItem`, and each adds only `readsByPackage: () => false`: - `packages/rest/src/rest-server-meta-history-diff-org-scope.test.ts` - `packages/rest/src/rest-server-meta-read-org-scope.test.ts` - `packages/runtime/src/meta-managed-content-seal.test.ts` - `packages/runtime/src/meta-write-org-scope.test.ts` - `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-catalog-echo.test.ts` (outside the card's named packages; see deviations) ## Tests - `packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts` runs on the real `SchemaRegistry`: - the fail-closed describe: a sliceless registry view gets 501 + `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` + `refusal: true` for `?package=`, the qualified path, `_env`, the bare read and the wire, with CONTROLs; - a new describe for rulings (a), (b) and (c), parameterized over the 11 unwired types and over `NAMESPACE_SCOPED_BARE_NAME_TYPES`. Its CONTROLs cover each holder's own read, the pair read, a row bound to the pair, the zero-holder miss with the env item, and a view's prefer-local read. - `packages/rest/src/meta-qualified-item-route.test.ts` and `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-qualified-item-read.test.ts`: the 501 through each transport, where the runtime never calls the service `getItem`. They also pin (c) through each door on a `queue`, asserting first that the registry reads a queue through `getItem`: `?package=C`, `/queue/gamma/status` and `/queue/_env/status` each get 409 naming `package "alpha"`, with CONTROLs. - `packages/rest/src/rest-environment-scoped-providers.test.ts`: the owner step reads `member` when the layers named one, and names none otherwise. The existing dogfood file `packages/qa/dogfood/test/email-template-dependent-unshipped-locale-read.dogfood.test.ts` pins the probe end to end through the runtime dispatcher. - `packages/core/src/package-scoped-resolution.test.ts`: the namespace-scoped types are bare-name one-holder covered types; `flow` is not one. - Every rejection pin asserts `status` and `code`. ## Acceptance notes - **Deviations** 1. Ruling (a) keeps the inherited `849692ba` reading: a `readsByPackage` false answer keeps `getItem` for a read naming no package. Measured: refusing it would 501 every bare read of the unwired types (14 then, 11 now) on every in-repo composition. The seat ruled (a) on that evidence. 2. `resolveItem` is required when `readsByPackage` answers true (inherited). 3. The core and objectql files widen the surface (ruling option A). 4. `plugin-security`'s stub sits outside the named packages. 5. The pair line in `exactQualifierItem` was not in the card. It keeps #28802's contract once (c) judges `email_template`. 6. The layered probe's member (`@objectstack/rest` src, and `@objectstack/runtime`) was not in the card either. It keeps #28830's contract once (c) judges `email_template`. `@objectstack/rest` joins the changeset. - **Out of scope:** wiring any of the 11 types into `PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES` belongs to the epic's reader children; `#31700` appends to the namespace-scoped list. - **Epic red-line read:** this is an ADR-0150 reader card. The epic seat (`epic:#31527#1`) reads it before landing; the seat routes that. ## Verification Every run below is in a worktree under `bash scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` (slot `dev-32076`), on a shared box. The complete chain ran on **eac48764** (`main` merged at 171cf6d9). Before the PR, `main` landed the sibling readers #32070 (`picklist`) and #32071 (`mapping`). I merged it at 036a9fbf with no conflict and moved the pins that used those two types. On the head that resulted, **8613b5fa**, the seat narrowed the rerun: closure rebuild, the suites of the four packages the diff moves most, the re-ablation of the moved pins, and the derived gates. CI and the merge queue's dogfood gate cover the rest. Then `main` landed #32098 (`dataset` now reads by package). Before opening the PR, I merged `main` at fb71296c (merge 2b00cabb, no conflict) and dropped `dataset` from the changeset's type list (0896703c, the PR head). The derived pins shrink with it to 11 types, and no pin names `dataset`. The refusal census reads the same at fb71296c. On 0896703c, the closure build passed: `npx turbo run build --filter='@objectstack/dogfood...' --filter='@objectstack/service-analytics...'`, 70/70 tasks, lock VERDICT command-exit 0. The seat asked for the PR to open while the rest of the rerun on 0896703c runs. That covers the objectql suite, the dataset, analytics and pin files of metadata-protocol, rest and runtime, the `service-analytics` suite, the dogfood files `dataset-package-scoped-readers` and `email-template-dependent-unshipped-locale-read`, and the same 80 gates. Its results go in the os-dev-report on #32076.

The rest and runtime reds include the queue door pin. - C2, `admitEnvironmentQualifier` gated on `readsByPackage` again: objectql 2/71, rest 1/18 (the queue door pin), runtime 1/25 (the queue door pin). - Each leg rebuilt `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, and `ablation-dist-preflight` found the marker in its `dist/` before the pins ran. Each restore put the file back to its HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty.
